lines.zh: 蠕动着巨大的身体向前爬行
lines.en: Slithering forward with immense bulk

lines.zh: 发出嘶嘶声，身体扭曲前行
lines.en: Sssss, twisting body forward

lines.zh: 身体快速扭动，寻找猎物
lines.en: Body twists quickly, seeking prey

lines.zh: 用触须感知周围环境
lines.en: Using tendrils to sense surroundings

lines.zh: 不断蠕动，试图逼近玩家
lines.en: Constantly slithering, trying to approach player

lines.zh: 快速扭动身体，准备攻击
lines.en: Body twists rapidly, preparing to attack

lines.zh: 用尖利的触角刺向敌人
lines.en: Sharp tentacles pierce enemies

lines.zh: 用长舌舔舐皮肤，试图驯服玩家
lines.en: Long tongue licks skin, trying to tame player

lines.zh: 快速扭动，试图吞噬玩家
lines.en: Body twists quickly, trying to swallow player

lines.zh: 快速游动，寻找新的猎物
lines.en: Quickly swimming, seeking new prey

lines.zh: 躺在黑暗中静静等待
lines.en: Lies still in darkness, waiting

lines.zh: 土里钻出来，身上还挂着泥。
lines.en: I rise from the dirt, mud still clinging.

lines.zh: 目光如炬，警惕着周围
lines.en: Keen eyes watching surroundings

lines.zh: 静静地躺着，等待机会
lines.en: Lies quietly, waiting for an opportunity

lines.zh: 静静地盯着远处
lines.en: Staring into the distance

lines.zh: 偶尔挪动身体，准备行动
lines.en: Occasionally shifts, readying itself

lines.zh: 静静地等待着猎物出现
lines.en: Patiently waiting for prey

lines.zh: 静静地观察周围的一切
lines.en: Quietly observing surroundings

lines.zh: 静待夜深，准备行动
lines.en: Waiting for night to fall

lines.zh: 静静地栖息在黑暗中
lines.en: Resides quietly in the dark

lines.zh: 盘成一圈，安静得像块石头
lines.en: Coiled into a ring, it sits still as stone.

lines.zh: 鳞片在夜里泛着淡淡的光
lines.en: Its scales give off a faint glow in the night.

lines.zh: 偶尔抬头，像是在等谁召唤
lines.en: It lifts its head now and then, as if awaiting a summons.

lines.zh: 身体一半埋进土里，一动不动
lines.en: Half its body buried, it does not stir.

lines.zh: 喉咙里滚出低沉的咕噜声
lines.en: A low rumble rolls in its throat.

lines.zh: 触须探出，慢慢扫过地面
lines.en: Its feelers reach out and sweep the ground.

lines.zh: 它把身子缩紧，蓄着下一次冲刺
lines.en: It coils tight, storing up its next lunge.

lines.zh: 深夜的凉意让它舒展身体
lines.en: The deep-night chill makes it stretch out.

lines.zh: 看见玩家立即加速攻击
lines.en: Sees player, immediately speeds up attack

lines.zh: 盯住玩家，准备一击致命
lines.en: Locks on to player, ready to deliver the killing blow

lines.zh: 锁定玩家，迅速调整位置
lines.en: Locks onto player, quickly adjusts position

lines.zh: 目光锁定玩家，准备进攻
lines.en: Fixes eyes on player, preparing to attack

lines.zh: 注视玩家，寻找攻击机会
lines.en: Observes player, looking for an opening

lines.zh: 目光锁定玩家，准备发动攻击
lines.en: Fixes gaze on player, readying attack

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，试图抓住机会
lines.en: Staring at player, looking for an opening

lines.zh: 盯紧玩家，等待最佳时机
lines.en: Holding gaze on player, waiting for the right moment

lines.zh: 锁定玩家，准备致命一击
lines.en: Locking onto player, ready for the final strike

lines.zh: 观察玩家，寻找最佳攻击点
lines.en: Observing player, searching for the perfect attack point

lines.zh: 它把整条身子转向你
lines.en: It turns its whole length toward you.

lines.zh: 隔着夜色，它记住了你的位置
lines.en: Through the dark, it memorizes where you stand.

lines.zh: 身体开始变得脆弱。
lines.en: Body starts to weaken.

lines.zh: 蠕动变得缓慢。
lines.en: Movement slows down.

lines.zh: 鳞片开始剥落。
lines.en: Scales start to peel off.

lines.zh: 力量正在消退。
lines.en: Strength fades away.

lines.zh: 伤口开始流血。
lines.en: Wounds start bleeding.

lines.zh: 疼痛让它蜷缩起来。
lines.en: Pain causes it to curl up.

lines.zh: 伤口在慢慢愈合。
lines.en: Wounds start to heal.

lines.zh: 疼痛让它无法集中注意力。
lines.en: Pain distracts it.

lines.zh: 它开始感到虚弱。
lines.en: It feels weak.

lines.zh: 它开始缓慢下来。
lines.en: It slows down.

lines.zh: 它的鳞片闪烁着以太光。
lines.en: Its scales shimmer with aether light.

lines.zh: 我闻到了它的以太气息。
lines.en: I smell the aether around it.

lines.zh: 它的心脏跳动着以太之心。
lines.en: Its heart beats with aether's pulse.

lines.zh: 它的血液像是流动的星光。
lines.en: Its blood flows like starlight.

lines.zh: 它体内藏着无尽的能量。
lines.en: In its body lies endless energy.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛盯着我的每一口食物。
lines.en: Its eyes lock onto every morsel I have.

lines.zh: 它的鳞片在月光下发出微光。
lines.en: Its scales glow faintly under moonlight.

lines.zh: 它仿佛在等待着什么。
lines.en: It seems to be waiting for something.

lines.zh: 我感受到它的强大意志。
lines.en: I feel its powerful will.

lines.zh: 它的每一次呼吸都充满力量。
lines.en: Each of its breaths is filled with power.

lines.zh: 它快速游动，击破空气。
lines.en: It swims fast, shattering the air.

lines.zh: 它的身体撞击出火花。
lines.en: Its body collides with sparks.

lines.zh: 撞击声震动了整个空间。
lines.en: The collision shakes the space.

lines.zh: 它的蠕动打破寂静。
lines.en: Its writhing breaks the silence.

lines.zh: 撞击地面，激起尘埃。
lines.en: It collides with the ground, raising dust.

lines.zh: 撞击发出雷鸣般声响。
lines.en: It collides with a thunderous sound.

lines.zh: 它的每一次触碰都带电。
lines.en: Its every touch is electric.

lines.zh: 碰撞的火花照亮了黑暗。
lines.en: The sparks from the collision light up the dark.

lines.zh: 它的身体扭曲碰撞。
lines.en: Its body twists and collides.

lines.zh: 撞击地面，引发震动。
lines.en: It collides with the ground, causing tremors.

lines.zh: 它寻找着同类。
lines.en: It seeks its kind.

lines.zh: 它用身体摩擦对方。
lines.en: It rubs against the other with its body.

lines.zh: 它释放出吸引的光芒。
lines.en: It emits an attracting light.

lines.zh: 它们互相低语着。
lines.en: They whisper to each other.

lines.zh: 我的躯干贴着另一条，缓缓缠绕。
lines.en: My body slides against another, slowly coiling.

lines.zh: 它的身体紧密相连。
lines.en: Its body is tightly joined.

lines.zh: 它们的触角轻轻触碰。
lines.en: Their antennae lightly touch.

lines.zh: 它们相互依偎。
lines.en: They snuggle together.

lines.zh: 它在交配中释放能量。
lines.en: It releases energy during mating.

lines.zh: 两条长身缓缓交缠在一起
lines.en: Two long bodies slowly wind together.

lines.zh: 它的鳞片闪烁着星光。
lines.en: Its scales glint with starlight.

lines.zh: 蠕动的身体中藏匿着光芒。
lines.en: Glory hides within its writhing form.

lines.zh: 它从黑暗中伸展出触手。
lines.en: It extends tentacles from the shadows.

lines.zh: 饥饿的叫声回荡在夜空中。
lines.en: Its hunger echoes through the night.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛如同深渊般深邃。
lines.en: Its eyes are as deep as the abyss.

lines.zh: 蠕虫体内涌动着未知的力量。
lines.en: Unknown power surges within the worm.

lines.zh: 它的鳞片在月光下闪耀。
lines.en: Its scales shine in the moonlight.

lines.zh: 触手上的光芒如同星辰。
lines.en: The light on its tentacles is like stars.

lines.zh: 它的鳞片反射出微弱的光芒。
lines.en: Its scales reflect a faint light.

lines.zh: 触手在夜色中悄然伸展。
lines.en: Tentacles creep out in the night.

lines.zh: 它锁定目标，准备攻击。
lines.en: It locks on, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 目标已被锁定，等待机会。
lines.en: Target locked, waiting for an opening.

lines.zh: 它盯紧猎物，准备一击毙命。
lines.en: It fixes its gaze on the prey.

lines.zh: 瞄准，锁定，准备攻击。
lines.en: Target acquired, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 它紧盯着目标，毫不放松。
lines.en: It watches the target intently.

lines.zh: 锁定目标，给予致命一击。
lines.en: Locking on, delivering the fatal blow.

lines.zh: 锁定猎物，准备致命攻击。
lines.en: Target locked, prepare for a fatal attack.

lines.zh: 锁定，瞄准，准备攻击。
lines.en: Lock on, aim, prepare to strike.

lines.zh: 瞄准猎物，准备致命一击。
lines.en: Aim at the prey, prepare the fatal blow.

lines.zh: 它停下蠕动，头部对准你
lines.en: It stops writhing and points its head at you.

lines.zh: 身体绷紧，像拉满的弓弦
lines.en: Its body tenses like a drawn bowstring.

lines.zh: 一声嘶鸣，它选定你当猎物
lines.en: With a hiss, it picks you as its prey.

lines.zh: 它在沙地上划出一道弧线逼近
lines.en: It carves an arc through the sand toward you.

lines.zh: 触须缠住你的脚，试着拖倒你
lines.en: A feeler wraps your foot and tries to trip you.

lines.zh: 它把泥土拱开，直冲你来
lines.en: It plows up the soil and charges straight at you.

lines.zh: 尾端一拍，它知道你跑不掉
lines.en: Its tail slaps the ground; it knows you cannot escape.

lines.zh: 黑暗中传来它锁定你的嘶声
lines.en: A hiss in the dark says it has locked onto you.

lines.zh: 它压低身子，蓄势待发
lines.en: It lowers its body, ready to spring.

lines.zh: 夜里的召唤让我快得看不清。
lines.en: Summoned at night, I move too fast to follow.

lines.zh: 锁定目标，准备行动。
lines.en: Target locked, ready to act.

lines.zh: 它开始追踪目标。
lines.en: It begins to track the target.

lines.zh: 目标已确定，现在瞄准。
lines.en: Target identified, now aim.

lines.zh: 锁定，瞄准目标。
lines.en: Locking on, aiming at the target.

lines.zh: 追踪目标，准备攻击。
lines.en: Tracking the target, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 夜里的以太蠕虫，从土里拱出来。
lines.en: At night the Aether worm pushes up from soil.

lines.zh: 我盘起长躯，沙土簌簌落下。
lines.en: I coil my long body; sand patters down.

lines.zh: 瞄准目标，锁定猎物。
lines.en: Targeting the target, locking on to the prey.

lines.zh: 锁定目标，准备捕获。
lines.en: Targeting, preparing to capture.

lines.zh: 它绕着你打转，找薄弱处
lines.en: It circles you, hunting for a weak spot.

lines.zh: 头高高扬起，随时会砸下来
lines.en: Its head rears high, ready to come down.

lines.zh: 它贴着地面滑行，沙土翻飞
lines.en: It slides along the ground, sand flying.

lines.zh: 嘶声越来越近，就在你身后
lines.en: The hissing grows closer, right behind you.

lines.zh: 它把你的影子当成落点
lines.en: It marks your shadow as its landing spot.

lines.zh: 一圈圈收紧，像绳索一样
lines.en: It tightens in rings, like a rope.

lines.zh: 你转身，它已换到另一边
lines.en: You turn, and it is already on the other side.

lines.zh: 它试探性地撞了你一下
lines.en: It tests you with a light bump.

lines.zh: 它伏低身体，只等夜色更浓
lines.en: It crouches low, waiting for the night to thicken.

lines.zh: 它的头跟着你的每一步移动
lines.en: Its head follows your every step.

lines.zh: 我从沙里竖起来，扭成一圈。
lines.en: I rise from sand and coil into a ring.

lines.zh: 蠕动的身躯，致命的攻击！
lines.en: Slithering body,致命 attack!

lines.zh: 触手缠绕，感受我的力量！
lines.en: Tentacles wrap, feel my power!

lines.zh: 你连逃跑的机会都没有！
lines.en: No chance to run!

lines.zh: 我的每一次攻击都致命！
lines.en: Each attack is deadly!

lines.zh: 你触碰到的都是死亡！
lines.en: What you touch is death!

lines.zh: 我的力量源自这片星空！
lines.en: My power comes from the stars!

lines.zh: 感受以太能量的怒火！
lines.en: Feel the fury of the aether!

lines.zh: 无处可逃，只有灭亡！
lines.en: Nowhere to run, only death!

lines.zh: 我的每一次挥动都是致命的！
lines.en: Each swing is deadly!

lines.zh: 整条身躯抽来，把你掀翻
lines.en: Its whole body lashes out and flips you over.

lines.zh: 尖牙咬住你的护甲，往里钻
lines.en: Fangs clamp your armor and bore inward.

lines.zh: 它一头撞在你胸口
lines.en: It slams its head into your chest.

lines.zh: 尾部横扫，把你扫出几步远
lines.en: A sweep of its tail throws you several steps back.

lines.zh: 夜晚，是我们的时刻！
lines.en: Night, our time!

lines.zh: 天空中有我的召唤！
lines.en: The sky calls me!

lines.zh: 梦境与现实的交界！
lines.en: The boundary of dreams and reality!

lines.zh: 黑暗中，我苏醒！
lines.en: I awaken in the dark!

lines.zh: 以太之力，觉醒！
lines.en: Aether power, awakening!

lines.zh: 吞噬梦魇，释放光明！
lines.en: Devour nightmares, release light!

lines.zh: 在这梦境与现实之间！
lines.en: Between dreams and reality!

lines.zh: 我是以太的守护者！
lines.en: I am the guardian of the aether!

lines.zh: 夜晚，属于以太娜迦！
lines.en: The night, for the Aether Naga!

lines.zh: 我的存在，即是黑夜！
lines.en: My presence is the night!

lines.zh: 夜里沙土翻起，它钻了出来
lines.en: At night the sand heaves and it emerges.

lines.zh: 召唤的嘶声在黑暗中响起
lines.en: A summoning hiss sounds in the dark.

lines.zh: 它从地底一节一节钻出
lines.en: It rises from the ground, segment by segment.

lines.zh: 月光下，巨大的影子铺开
lines.en: Under the moon, a huge shadow spreads.

lines.zh: 孢子与尘土中，它直起身
lines.en: Through spores and dust, it rears up.

lines.zh: 大地裂开一道蜿蜒的缝
lines.en: The earth splits in a winding seam.

lines.zh: 它以嘶鸣宣告自己的到来
lines.en: It announces itself with a long hiss.

lines.zh: 夜风带来它的腥气
lines.en: The night wind carries its stench.

lines.zh: 沙丘起伏，它就在下面
lines.en: The dune ripples; it is underneath.

lines.zh: 它盘在月光里，等你靠近
lines.en: It coils in the moonlight, waiting for you to come near.

lines.zh: 火焰灼烧着我的皮肤。
lines.en: Flames burn my skin.

lines.zh: 坠落的冲击撕裂了我的身体。
lines.en: Impact of fall rips my body.

lines.zh: 水淹没了我的呼吸孔。
lines.en: Water blocks my breathing.

lines.zh: 爆炸撕开了我的皮肤。
lines.en: Explosion tears my skin.

lines.zh: 箭钉进我的腹节，我拧得更快。
lines.en: An arrow lodges in my segment and I twist faster.

lines.zh: 魔法之力侵蚀了我的鳞片。
lines.en: Magic erodes my scales.

lines.zh: 饥饿感越来越强。
lines.en: Hunger grows stronger.

lines.zh: 闪电击中了我的神经。
lines.en: Lightning sears my nerves.

lines.zh: 虚空之力侵蚀着我的身躯。
lines.en: Void erodes my body.
